entities.summary: Marvin Bower was an American business theorist and management consultant associated with McKinsey & Company. Under Bower's leadership, McKinsey grew from a small engineering and accounting firm to a leader in the consulting industry. Bower, alongside Edwin G. Booz, is regarded one of the individuals most responsible for the rise of management consulting after World War II; he is considered by many to be the "father" of the modern consulting industry.". Marvin Bower was a legal figures from Cincinnati (1903-08-01, Cincinnati–2003-01-22). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
